title: The alphabet
examples: Teacher, what sound does the letter B make?
Can you show me the letter that comes after G?
What word starts with the letter T?

explain.say: Today you will learn the alphabet. Letters have names and sounds.

draw.text: A to Z: Names and Sounds

explain.say: Start with the letter A. A makes the sound at the start of apple.
Next is the letter B. B makes the sound at the start of ball.
The letter C makes the sound at the start of cat.
The letter D makes the sound at the start of dog.
The letter E makes the sound at the start of egg. Listen to the sound.

faq.q: What is the difference between the letter name and the letter sound?
faq.a: The name is what you call the letter, like A in the alphabet song. The sound is what A says at the start of apple.
asks: How do I say the letter?
What sound does the letter make?

faq.q: Do I learn all the letters at once?
faq.a: No. You learn a few letters at a time.
asks: Is it okay to learn some letters first?
How long will it take to learn them all?

faq.q: What if I forget a sound?
faq.a: That is okay. Just try to remember it by looking at a picture that starts with that sound.
asks: What should I do if I forget?

faq.q: Are the sounds the same in all English books?
faq.a: Most books use the standard sounds we are learning. Sometimes there are little differences.
asks: Is the sound always the same?

faq.a: The alphabet is the set of letters we use to write words.
asks: Can you show me the alphabet?

facts: The English alphabet has twenty six letters.
Each letter has a name and a sound.
The letters are arranged in a specific order.
Learning the sounds helps you read words.

quiz.say: Look at the moon. Which letter does moon start with?
quiz.why: Moon starts with the mmm sound. The letter M makes that sound.

wrong.1: N makes the sound at the start of nest.
wrong.2: W looks like M upside down, and it starts the word web.

quiz.say: Look at the tiger. Which letter does tiger start with?
quiz.why: Tiger starts with the T sound.

wrong.0: D makes the sound at the start of dog.
wrong.2: F looks a bit like T, and it starts the word fish.

quiz.say: Look at the ball. Which letter does ball start with?
quiz.why: Ball starts with the B sound.

wrong.0: D faces the other way from B, and it starts the word dog.
wrong.1: P makes the sound at the start of pig.
